title: 《佛子行三十七颂》--科判
author: 子茗（圓雲）
definition: {"nodes":[{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"5416d32a83d2d01c","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【那莫罗革那绕雅！】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","heading":3,"id":"2cb16d32a7d9d50b5","modified":1612428569546,"text":"总顶礼"},{"children":[{"color":"#dc2d1e","id":"33216d32a9004911b","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【虽见诸法无来去，然唯精勤利众者，胜师怙主观音前，三门恒时敬顶礼。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","heading":3,"id":"3116d32a7ed3c0ff","modified":1612428569546,"text":"分别顶礼（与观世音菩萨无别的上师）"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#75c940","heading":2,"id":"6816d32a70ad9024","modified":1612428569546,"text":"礼赞"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"26316d32ae58b2083","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【利乐之源诸佛陀，修持正法而成就，亦依了知其行故，于此宣说佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":2,"id":"10c16d32a7a87b0fa","modified":1612428569546,"text":"立誓造论"}],"color":"#3da8f5","heading":1,"id":"21816d32a5374e09d","modified":1612428569546,"text":"初义（礼赞与立誓造论）"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"f816d32b36a630a","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【已获暇满大舟时，为自他渡轮回海，日日夜夜不懈怠，闻思修持佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","finish":false,"heading":3,"id":"1d316d32b0cf990e","modified":1612428569546,"text":"当使难得之暇满人身具义"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"fb16d32b3b32318c","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【贪恋亲方如沸水，嗔恨敌方如烈火，遗忘取舍愚暗者，抛弃故乡佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","finish":false,"heading":3,"id":"1b416d32b0e125144","modified":1612428569546,"text":"抛弃三毒根源之故乡"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"heading":0,"id":"2b816d32b46daf132","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【离恶境故惑渐轻，无散乱故善自增，净心于法生定解，居于静处佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","finish":false,"heading":3,"id":"35316d32b0f407029","modified":1612428569546,"text":"依止功德源泉之静处"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"heading":0,"id":"28b16d32b50da615c","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【长伴亲友各分离，勤积之财留后世，识客终离身客店，舍弃今世佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","finish":false,"heading":3,"id":"1c116d32b10ac20a5","modified":1612428569546,"text":"忆念无常而放下今生"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"heading":0,"id":"4816d32b53bba163","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【交往恶人增三毒，失坏闻思修事业，令成无有慈悲者，远离恶友佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","heading":3,"id":"11316d32b113be006","modified":1612428569546,"text":"远离违缘之恶友"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"heading":0,"id":"17416d32b5b465053","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【依止正士灭罪业，功德增如上弦月，殊胜上师较自身，更为珍爱佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","heading":3,"id":"24d16d32b12038079","modified":1612428569546,"text":"依止顺缘之善知识"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"heading":0,"id":"2e616d32b60a9e081","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【己尚缚于轮回狱，世间天神能救谁？故知殊胜无欺处，皈依三宝佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","finish":false,"heading":3,"id":"24416d32b0b3fa10d","modified":1612428569546,"text":"佛教入门之皈依。"}],"color":"#75c940","heading":2,"id":"4816d32afa640094","modified":1612428569546,"text":"入前行法之方式"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"3a616d32b8336c05d","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【佛说难忍恶趣苦，皆为恶业之果报，是故纵遇生命难，永不造罪佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","heading":3,"id":"31c16d32b781f90ae","modified":1612428569546,"text":"小士道畏惧恶趣之苦而断除罪业"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"cd16d32b88daf119","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【三有乐如草尖露，乃是瞬间坏灭法，了知恒时无变法，希求解脱佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","heading":3,"id":"10a16d32b78bb60a","modified":1612428569546,"text":"中士道不贪三有而希求解脱"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"c616d32b9196403b","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【无始时来慈我者，诸母若苦自何乐？是故为度无边众，发菩提心佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"31416d32b8fa1814e","modified":1612428569546,"text":"意乐发殊胜菩提心"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2a416d32b9ea4c0dd","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【诸苦由求自乐生，圆满正觉利他成，是故己乐与他苦，真实相换佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"10b16d32b9bedc14d","modified":1612428569546,"text":"入定修自他相换"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"14f16d32bc547510b","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【何人以大贪欲心，夺或令夺我诸财，自身受用三世善，回向于他佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"21816d32bc216210e","modified":1612428569546,"text":"未得利养转为道用"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"29316d32c4a7de0aa","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【我虽无有些微错，何人若断吾头颅，然以悲心将彼罪，自身代受佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"26d16d32bc2a1813b","modified":1612428569546,"text":"痛苦转为道用"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"e916d32c4f91c14f","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【有者百般中伤吾，恶名纵遍三千界，然我深怀慈爱心，赞其功德佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"3a316d32bc33e104c","modified":1612428569546,"text":"恶名转为道用"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"29816d32c594120e7","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【何人大庭广众中，揭露吾过出恶语，于彼亦作上师想，恭敬顶礼佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"finish":false,"id":"24116d32bc134c034","modified":1612428569546,"text":"诽谤转为道用"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"c16d32bb605e14d","modified":1612428569546,"text":"四种不欲转为道用"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"8a16d32c68cbc11e","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【吾如自子爱护者，彼纵视我如怨敌，犹如慈母于病儿，尤为怜爱佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"37f16d32c6271b115","modified":1612428569546,"text":"恩将仇报转为道用"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2c616d32c7e296031","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【与我等同或下士，虽以傲慢而凌辱，然吾敬其如上师，恒时顶戴佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"finish":false,"id":"1ba16d32c611b3163","modified":1612428569546,"text":"凌辱转为道用"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"17016d32bb6898127","modified":1612428569546,"text":"安忍困难转为道用"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"3a616d32c9c300137","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【贫穷恒常受人欺，且为重疾恶魔逼，众生罪苦自代受，无有怯懦佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"a316d32c9a18904","modified":1612428569546,"text":"衰败转为道用"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"ee16d32ca1342119","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【美名远扬众人敬，亦获财如多闻子，然见世福无实义，毫无傲慢佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"finish":false,"id":"ac16d32c99037098","modified":1612428569546,"text":"兴盛转为道用"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"3db16d32bb71dc039","modified":1612428569546,"text":"兴衰转为道用"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"27516d32ca9e7a035","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【自嗔心敌若未降，降伏外敌反增强，故以慈悲之军队，调伏自心佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"bf16d32ca8629147","modified":1612428569546,"text":"嗔境转为道用"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"1b516d32cb23b709a","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【一切妙欲如盐水，愈享受之愈增贪，令生贪恋诸事物，即刻放弃佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"finish":false,"id":"7f16d32ca75fc001","modified":1612428569546,"text":"贪境转为道用"}],"collapsed":true,"finish":false,"id":"33316d32bb522f11c","modified":1612428569546,"text":"贪嗔转为道用"}],"collapsed":true,"finish":false,"id":"14716d32b9b120012","modified":1612428569546,"text":"后得恶缘转为道用"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"2de16d32b98f5216c","modified":1612428569546,"text":"修世俗菩提心"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"f916d32cbb86f05","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【一切境现唯心造，心性本来离戏边，了达此理于二取，皆不作意佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"1f816d32cb9d2004f","modified":1612428569546,"text":"入定修离戏无执"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"21016d32cd601001c","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【逢遇悦意对境时，视如夏季之彩虹，虽显美妙然无实，断除贪执佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"12616d32cd40fe0da","modified":1612428569546,"text":"于贪境断除实执"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"9816d32cf540013d","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【诸苦如同梦子死，迷现执实诚疲惫，是故遭遇违缘时，视为幻相佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"finish":false,"id":"19e16d32cd306c00f","modified":1612428569546,"text":"于嗔境断除实执"}],"collapsed":true,"finish":false,"id":"24316d32cb8b69105","modified":1612428569546,"text":"后得于贪嗔对境断除实执"}],"collapsed":true,"finish":false,"id":"17f16d32b981be12e","modified":1612428569546,"text":"修胜义菩提心"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"29e16d32b900b00f7","modified":1612428569546,"text":"加行修二菩提心"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"18716d32d2cabb194","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【获得菩提身尚舍，何况一切身外物，故不图报异熟果，慷慨布施佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"12016d32d287ef0ae","modified":1612428569546,"text":"布施度"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"28716d32d3151603","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【无戒自利尚不成，欲成他利诚可笑，故于三有无希求，守护净戒佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"2dd16d32d290940d8","modified":1612428569546,"text":"持戒度"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"3616d32d3f0d410d","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【于求妙果之佛子，一切损害如宝藏，故于诸众无怨恨，修持安忍佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"2fd16d32d29a5f0fe","modified":1612428569546,"text":"安忍度"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2c616d32d429c8146","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【唯成自利小乘士，勤如扑灭燃头火，饶益众生功德源，具足精进佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"2e416d32d2a4880ad","modified":1612428569546,"text":"精进度"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"17f16d32d4da0c0a9","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【当知止观双运理，以此摧毁诸烦恼，真实超越四无色，修习禅定佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"30916d32d2aef5049","modified":1612428569546,"text":"静虑度"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"33516d32d56f3b0ac","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【若无智慧以五度，不得圆满菩提果，故以方便三轮空，修持智慧佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"finish":false,"id":"2ec16d32d25b8b173","modified":1612428569546,"text":"智慧度"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"fb16d32d22d300f7","modified":1612428569546,"text":"修学六度"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"2a216d32d677520d2","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【若未观察自错误，以法形相行非法，是故恒时审自己，断除过患佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"3c716d32d647ba171","modified":1612428569546,"text":"自观自之错误而断除"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"3ca16d32d6f477135","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【以惑谈他菩萨过，则将毁坏自功德，故于大乘诸士夫，不说过失佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"a416d32d651cf","modified":1612428569546,"text":"断除谈论菩萨之过"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"28a16d32d77fb80c3","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【为求利养相互争，失坏闻思修事业，故于亲友施主众，根除贪执佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"f516d32d65a88106","modified":1612428569546,"text":"于施主断除贪恋"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"18416d32d7e41813c","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【恶言刺伤他人心，亦失菩萨品行故，莫说他人不悦词，杜绝粗语佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"finish":false,"id":"27d16d32d634000db","modified":1612428569546,"text":"断除说粗语"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"1dc16d32d237dd01b","modified":1612428569546,"text":"修学经中所说四法"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"5416d32d85b5602f","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【烦恼串习难对治，执持正知正念剑，贪等烦恼初生时，立即铲除佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"25416d32d240c1115","modified":1612428569546,"text":"修学断烦恼之理"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"f16d32d8ebd114e","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【总之一切威仪中，观心处于何状态，相续具足正知念，成办他利佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"id":"5916d32d24bc4107","modified":1612428569546,"text":"修学以正知念而成办他利"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"heading":0,"id":"1b716d32d9ba3301c","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【如是勤修诸善根，为除无边众生苦，皆以三轮清净慧，回向菩提佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"finish":false,"id":"9216d32d20e940c6","modified":1612428569546,"text":"善根回向圆满菩提"}],"collapsed":true,"finish":false,"id":"38116d32b8e8bb131","modified":1612428569546,"text":"修学菩提心学处。"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#797ec9","finish":false,"heading":3,"id":"cb16d32b7527c052","modified":1612428569546,"text":"大士道修空性大悲双运而解脱有寂之边"}],"color":"#75c940","heading":2,"id":"2dc16d32afae39029","modified":1612428569546,"text":"正行宣说三士道"}],"color":"#3da8f5","heading":1,"id":"36116d32a6c6770da","modified":1612428569546,"text":"论义（所造论之自性）"},{"children":[{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"id":"9116d32dabf5b05b","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【为利欲修菩萨道，依照经续论典义，诸圣者言而撰著，三十七颂佛子行。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","heading":2,"id":"3da16d32da8c58126","modified":1612428569546,"text":"为何如何造论"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"heading":0,"id":"13116d32db19760a","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【因吾慧浅无修行，虽无智者所喜词，然依诸多经论故，此佛子行定无谬。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","finish":false,"heading":2,"id":"4b16d32da9570163","modified":1612428569546,"text":"无误宣说"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"heading":0,"id":"3616d32db4b74074","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【而诸佛子广大行，如我愚者难测故，相违不符等诸过，诸圣者前祈宽恕。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","finish":false,"heading":2,"id":"4e16d32da9e3001a","modified":1612428569546,"text":"谦虚请求宽恕"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"heading":0,"id":"12f16d32dbb3d7094","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【以此善愿众有情，以胜世俗菩提心，等同不住有寂边，大悲怙主观自在。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","finish":false,"heading":2,"id":"28616d32daa7a9148","modified":1612428569546,"text":"造论善根回向菩提"},{"children":[{"collapsed":false,"color":"#dc2d1e","finish":false,"heading":0,"id":"39516d32dc165d17","modified":1612428569546,"text":"【此佛子行，是为利益自他而教理法师无著于水银宝洞撰写。】"}],"collapsed":true,"color":"#75c940","finish":false,"heading":2,"id":"15916d32da68400f1","modified":1612428569546,"text":"具四圆满之结尾"}],"collapsed":false,"color":"#3da8f5","finish":false,"heading":1,"id":"bb16d32a61af3118","modified":1612428569546,"text":"末义"}]}
